q: Will other guests join my tour?
a: Rarely. Most tours run with just your party, but other travelers can book the same date and time, so now and then you may share the walk. Your price per person depends on how many adults are in your own booking.

It depends on how many adults are in your booking: 1 adult ¥8,000, 2 adults ¥4,000 each, 3 adults ¥2,800 each, 4 or more adults ¥2,500 each. Anything you buy along the way (for example, your own hanko seal) is paid separately at the shop. The E-Scooter tour is ¥5,000 per person.
Of course! Kids 12 and under join free, however many you bring. They just need to come with a paying adult.

q: What language is the tour in?
a: Our Ninja guides lead tours in English.
Pick a tour, tap “Check availability”, then choose a date and time and complete your booking online. A confirmation email follows.

Yes. Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before the start time. Later cancellations, no-shows and late arrivals who miss the tour are not refunded. If you booked through a booking site, cancel and get your refund there.
Tours run rain or shine. If we cancel for stormy or dangerous weather, you get a full refund.
Each tour page shows the exact meeting point with a photo and a Google Maps link.

q: Why book here instead of a booking site?
a: Booking sites charge us a commission, so you get the best price when you book directly on this website.
